name: AC To Testing
description: Turns acceptance-criteria items into structured testing procedures via TPM + user collaboration, written to the Obsidian per-ticket notes' Testing Procedures section.

procedureTemplate.label: Procedure Template
procedureTemplate.description: Template for each testing procedure. steps-expected-edge (default): adds Steps, Expected Outcome, and Edge Cases. steps-expected: drops Edge Cases. gherkin: produces Given/When/Then blocks.

autoOfferOnAcComplete.label: Auto-Offer On AC Complete
autoOfferOnAcComplete.description: When on (default), TPM offers to draft testing procedures as soon as the user signals AC is complete. When off, TPM only generates them on explicit request.

oneProcedurePerAcItem.label: One Procedure Per AC Item
oneProcedurePerAcItem.description: When on (default), TPM writes a separate testing procedure per AC item, easing later Playwright mapping. When off, TPM writes one consolidated procedure covering all AC items.

probeEdgeCases.label: Probe Edge Cases
probeEdgeCases.description: When on (default), TPM asks the user for edge cases per AC item during generation (null inputs, boundary values, permission denials, etc.). When off, it only captures edge cases the user volunteers.

writeToNotes.label: Write To Notes
writeToNotes.description: When on (default), TPM writes procedures to the ticket's notes file (requires tool.obsidian-notes and a resolved vault). When off, procedures appear in session output only and don't persist across sessions.
